visual_action: The video opens with a close-up of Donald Trump speaking at a podium with an American flag in the background. It then cuts to a montage of B-roll footage showing U.S. border patrol agents on horseback and on ATVs patrolling a desert-like landscape near a border wall. Some shots are in color, others are in black and white. The montage includes aerial views and shots of agents at dusk.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Shown speaking at the beginning ('But it turned out that all we really needed was a new president.') and named in on-screen text and audio ('Trump succeeded').

cast.name: unnamed commentators
cast.evidence: Multiple unidentified voices are heard praising border security in a montage, with lines like 'the border is the most stable now' and 'the most secure border in the history of this nation.'

spoken_summary: The video begins with Donald Trump saying, 'But it turned out that all we really needed was a new president.' This is followed by a series of audio clips from unidentified speakers who assert that the border is the 'most stable now than it's been in decades' and the 'most secure border in the history of this nation.' The audio concludes with a voice stating, 'Trump succeeded. He has shut the border down.'
audio_music: The video features the upbeat and triumphant-sounding song 'Dog Days Are Over' by Florence + The Machine playing throughout, reinforcing a sense of success and accomplishment.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between a talking-head clip of Donald Trump and various B-roll shots of border patrol activities. Some clips are color-graded or shown in black and white for stylistic effect.
cultural_references: The song 'Dog Days Are Over' by Florence + The Machine is used as the soundtrack.
central_claim: Donald Trump's presidency has resulted in the most secure U.S. border in modern history.
intended_effect: To persuade the viewer that Trump has successfully and decisively solved the issue of border security, generating feelings of pride and support for his administration.
uncertainty_flags: The identities of the speakers in the audio montage, other than Trump, are not provided in the video.
